{{Quote|Finally, Gram Cortess, of Alderaan."<br />"Princess.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and Gram Cortess|<ref name="Star Wars (2013) 2">[[Star Wars (2013) 2|''Star Wars'' (2013) 2]]</ref>}}
'''Gram Cortess''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] he became a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], where he preformed with enough skill and was deemed trustworthy enough to be selected by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to be part of a [[Stealth Squadron|team]] to uncover a mole within the alliance. The team worked entirely off the books, with only [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] knowing of their existence outside of the team's members. As well as discovering the mole they were also tasked with finding a suitable planet on which the alliance could set up a new base.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gram Cortess first appeared in first appeared in the [[Star Wars (2013) 2|second issue]] of the comic book series titled simply [[Star Wars (2013)|Star Wars]] published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The issue was written by [[Brian Wood]], illustrated by [[Carlos D'Anda]] and colored by [[Gabe Eltaeb]]. It was released on [[February]] [[February 13|13]] [[2013]].
